variety_description: High yielding, late maturity, medium tall, medium bold variety suitable for cultivation under rainfed lowland conditions. Developed by BRRI and released in 1980 for planting in Bangladesh in Aman season. Tolerant to Tungro, yellow stem borer. Lodging tolerant
